content:
We got list of templates. Need the one that when applied to product yields the precursors we have. The precursors are sulfonamide and aniline. The template likely is the one that forms S-N bond from sulfonyl chloride and aniline. Looking at results: The first template (reaction_id 1379509) has retro_smarts_template: '[O;D1;H0:2]=[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:3])(-[c:4])-[N;H0;D3;+0:6](-[c:5])-[c:7]>>Cl-[S;H0;D4;+0:1](=[O;D1;H0:2])(=[O;D1;H0:3])-[c:4].[c:5]-[NH;D2;+0:6]-[c:7]'

This is a sulfonyl chloride reacting with aniline to give sulfonamide. That matches our precursors: sulfonyl chloride (Cl attached to sulfonyl) and aniline. However our first precursor is not sulfonyl chloride but sulfonyl phenyl with cinnamic acid. But the template would generate that sulfonyl chloride as reactant, which then reacts with aniline to give product. The product is sulfonamide. So the template is appropriate.

Thus we need to return mapped_rxn and template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The template_id likely is the integer ID of the template in catalog. In result, we have 'reaction_id' and 'template_hash'. The template_id expected is integer (the one used to search the database not the hash). Probably the 'reaction_id' is the template ID? Or there is separate template_id field not shown. In result, each dict includes 'reaction_id', 'template_hash', 'retro_smarts_template', etc. The template_id likely corresponds to 'reaction_id' or maybe there is a field 'template_id' not shown. The description: "Return a dict with the `mapped_rxn` as a string and the `template_id` (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". So we should use 'reaction_id' as template_id.

Thus choose the first template (most similar). Mapped_rxn is given: a long string. We'll extract it.

Mapped_rxn from first entry:
'[N:21]#[C:20][c:19]1[cH:18][cH:17][c:16]([NH:9][c:10]2[cH:11][cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15]2)[cH:23][cH:22]1.Cc1ccccc1.[H-].[Na+].O.[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][c:5]([S:6](=[O:7])(=[O:8])Cl)[cH:24][cH:25]1>>[CH3:1][c:2]1[cH:3][cH:4][c:5]([S:6](=[O:7])(=[O:8])[N:9]([c:10]2[cH:11][cH:12][cH:13][cH:14][cH:15]2)[c:16]2[cH:17][cH:18][c:19]([C:20]#[N:21])[cH:22][cH:23]2)[cH:24][cH:25]1'

That's the mapped reaction.

Now produce final answer JSON.
